notes: AI-drafted Telegram posts now get the channel's own recent history (last 8 posts of the same kind, excluding anything rejected) fed back into the prompt as "don't repeat this wording/angle" context - both the blog-summary and service-announcement prompts gained a new {{recent_posts}} placeholder for this. telegram_posts itself was already a permanent history (rows are never auto-pruned) - this just puts it to use during generation instead of only being browsable on the Queue page. NOTE: if the blog/service announcement prompt was already saved (not left at default) before this update, it won't pick up the new placeholder automatically - use the "Reset ... prompt to default" buttons on Telegram Settings if you want it, or add {{recent_posts}} to your own custom prompt by hand.
